{"metadata":{"description":"Play a Minecraft villager hmm whenever the model hums inside its reasoning chain. DeepSeek Harness plugin.","id":"gh:1364483541","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-villager-hmm","slug":"nagatoquin33/dsh-villager-hmm","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Play a Minecraft villager hmm whenever the model hums inside its reasoning chain. DeepSeek Harness p"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" Minecraft villager hmm whenever the model hums inside its reasoning chain. DeepSeek Harness plugin."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-villager-hmm"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin.
Whenever the model goes *"hmm"* — inside its chain of thought, or in the "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"reply
itself — a Minecraft villager hums back at you."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A villager stands in the top-right corner, bobs on every hit, and carries the
controls: pause, volum"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"e, which stream to watch, and the matcher itself."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**Drag the title bar to move it; double-click the bar to send it back to the
corner.** The position "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"is remembered in `localStorage`. It defaults to the
top-right rather than the bottom-right on purpos"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"e — the composer is full-width,
so a bottom-anchored overlay would sit on top of the send button."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"**Collapsed, the panel shrinks to nothing but the villager's head** (a
32x44 crop of the face plus n"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ose). Clicking the head pets the villager; the
small `▣` button under it restores the full panel. Th"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"e head still drags, and
it bobs on every hmm, just like the full figure. See "Petting" below."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The panel follows the interface language: it registers English and Chinese
dictionaries with the sha"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"red `locale` service and re-renders when the locale
changes. If that service is unavailable it falls"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" back to English rather than
failing to render."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"That is the whole install. The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so `dsh plugin`
registers it as a prof"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ile layer by itself — there is no configuration file to
edit. Restart the profile when it finishes."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Never install into a profile with plain `npm install` / `npm update`: profiles
are pnpm workspaces m"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"anaged by the harness, and a package that arrives outside
that flow is invisible to the host's enume"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ration — the plugin loads on neither
side, with no error anywhere (the panel just never appears). If"},{"id":"p12s4","text":" that happened,
`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-villager-hmm` followed by the `add` above
repai"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"happened,
`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-villager-hmm` followed by the `add` above
repairs it."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Then fetch the assets, from the profile directory (where the package's `bin` is
linked):"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Skip this step and the plugin still loads. It shows its panel and prints the
exact command to run — "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"with an absolute path, so it works from any directory —
and never fails silently."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Assets"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**This package ships no Minecraft material.** The villager's sounds and textures
are fetched on your"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" machine into a per-user cache:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The damage clips are named `hit*`, not `hurt*`: the game's own `sounds.json`
maps the `entity.villag"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"er.hurt` event onto `mob/villager/hit1..hit4`, and no
`hurt*.ogg` exists in the vanilla assets."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The panel shows the exact command if the cache is empty. Two sources are
supported:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Flag | Meaning |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| *(none)* | Download from a public mirror of the vanilla 1.21.4 client assets |
| `--from <dir>` | "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"Copy from an asset tree you extracted yourself — **the option that matches the game's terms** |
| `-"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"-base <url>` | Your own mirror with the same layout |
| `--dir <path>` | Use a different cache direc"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"tory |
| `--force` | Re-fetch files that are already there |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The cache lives outside `node_modules`, so it survives plugin upgrades. The host
half re-reads it pe"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"r request, so running the fetch script takes effect on a page
reload — no harness restart."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Defaults live in the row. To override them, replace the insert in your own
`$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/c"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"the row. To override them, replace the insert in your own
`$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Everything except `assetDir` is also editable from the floating panel."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"`mode` defaults to `both` on purpose: plenty of models expose no separate
reasoning channel, and a p"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"lugin that silently does nothing looks broken. Switch
to `reasoning` once you have confirmed your mo"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"del streams `reasoning-delta` —
the panel's **Reasoning** counter tells you: if it climbs, you have "},{"id":"p29s4","text":"a reasoning
channel and can narrow the scope."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## The matcher"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"The default pattern is
`(?<![0-9A-Za-z])(?:h+m+|mhm+|m{2,})|[嗯唔哼呃]`."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"It uses a **lookbehind rather than `\b`**, for two reasons:"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- `\b` is ASCII-only in JavaScript, so it behaves unpredictably next to CJK
characters — `嗯hmm` woul"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"d not match.
- The CJK branch deliberately has no boundary at all, because those characters
are alwa"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"ys standalone interjections."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"`h+m+` covers `hm`, `hmm`, `hmmm…`; `mhm+` covers the closed-mouth variant;
`m{2,}` covers a bare `m"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"m`. None of them fire inside ordinary words — `comma`,
`comment`, `command` and `ahmm` all stay sile"},{"id":"p34s3","text":" None of them fire inside ordinary words — `comma`,
`comment`, `command` and `ahmm` all stay silent."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Write your own in the panel's **匹配式** field and hit **应用**. A pattern that
does not compile is repor"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"ted inline instead of being swallowed."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"The host half listens to the `agent/assistant-stream` event and scans
`reasoning-delta` (and optiona"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"lly `text-delta`) chunks against the matcher. The
browser half polls that counter over the plugin's "},{"id":"p37s3","text":"own HTTP prefix and plays a
sound per hit."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"**The plugin only consumes.** It registers one event listener and one HTTP
prefix route; it publishe"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"s no service and patches nothing. If the harness stops
emitting the event, or the overlay slot disap"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"pears, the plugin degrades to doing
nothing — it does not take the boot or the page with it."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"Two details shape the scanner:"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"**`frame.revision` is not a stream identity.** It increments on *every* frame.
Keying the scan buffe"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"r by it resets the buffer on every delta, so the matcher
only ever sees one character and never matc"},{"id":"p40s3","text":"hes. The buffer is keyed by
`attemptId:turn:step`."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"**The scan is inline, not debounced.** Deltas arrive far faster than any
debounce window, so every n"},{"id":"p41s2","text":"ew delta cancels the pending timer before it can
fire. Because the matcher keeps a consumed-offset c"},{"id":"p41s3","text":"ursor, scanning on every
delta is amortised O(n). A match that ends exactly at the buffer end is def"},{"id":"p41s4","text":"erred
unless the attempt is finishing, so `hm` is never counted before the next delta
can turn it in"},{"id":"p41s5","text":"ess the attempt is finishing, so `hm` is never counted before the next delta
can turn it into `hmm`."}],"truncated":true}
